learningObjective: Define TTFT precisely and use timeline data to diagnose which phase drives it.
stem: The latency budget for one request is broken down in the timeline below. Which choice correctly identifies TTFT and its dominant contributor for this request?
profileData:
Per-request timeline (single request, batch size 1):
  T0: request arrives at server
  T0 → T0 + 5 ms  : queueing (server busy with other requests)
  T0 + 5 ms  → T0 + 8 ms  : tokenization + input transfer
  T0 + 8 ms  → T0 + 190 ms: prefill of a 1024-token prompt on a single GPU
  T0 + 190 ms → T0 + 210 ms: first token generation (decode step 1) + detokenize + response send
  T0 + 210 ms → T0 + 500 ms: subsequent 30 decode steps (average 9.7 ms/token)

options.text: TTFT is the total decode time (about 310 ms in this trace); the dominant factor is the per-step decode latency, so mitigation should focus on speeding up decode via KV cache quantization or speculative decoding.

TTFT is only the queueing time (5 ms here); the prefill and decode contribute to throughput but not TTFT because those computations happen 'inside' the model and are amortized across all output tokens.

TTFT = time from request arrival to when the first output token is available (~210 ms here). It is dominated by the 182 ms prefill of the 1024-token prompt; mitigation focuses on prefill (chunked prefill, prefix caching, tensor parallelism).
TTFT is the average inter-token latency of subsequent decode steps (~9.7 ms/token in this trace); it excludes the prefill, which is a separate metric usually called 'time-to-prefill-complete'.

explanation: TTFT (Time To First Token) is the wall-clock time from when the request arrives at the server to when the first output token is delivered. In this trace: 5 ms queue + 3 ms tokenize/transfer + 182 ms prefill + ~20 ms first-token generation/response = ~210 ms. The dominant component is the 182 ms prefill of the 1024-token prompt. Mitigations targeting TTFT focus on prefill: chunked prefill (overlap with decode of other requests), prefix caching (skip prefill for cache-hit prefixes), and tensor parallelism (parallelize prefill compute).

optionExplanations.A: Wrong: this describes total generation latency, not TTFT.
optionExplanations.B: Wrong: TTFT includes all wall-clock time until the first token, not just queueing.
optionExplanations.C: Correct: TTFT definition and its prefill-dominated composition here.
optionExplanations.D: Wrong: that is TPOT (Time Per Output Token) / inter-token latency, not TTFT.

assumptions: 'First token' is delivered as soon as it is available (streaming).
Tokenization and detokenize are minor components and included in TTFT bookkeeping.
nonImplications: Does not imply that reducing prefill always reduces TTFT proportionally; other components (queueing under load) may become dominant.
Does not imply that TTFT is the only or most important metric; TPOT and throughput matter too.

distractorRationales.A: Confuses TTFT with total generation time.
distractorRationales.B: Reduces TTFT to queue time only.

performanceClaim.scope: TTFT definition and its contributor breakdown in a batch-1 request
